storylines: GORD: I want a dangerous group, not four equal mediocre groups. Spread the jam too thin and you've got nobody who actually scares anybody. CASEY: We both want the same thing, I just think the insurance matters. The Wolfpack Friday — I'm going to say Gomien finds the net again. He's in form, he's making plays, and I like him in a road environment. GORD: I'll say the third period has to change before anything else does. One thing at a time. Friday, October thirtieth, ten-fifty PM, road game against the Wolfpack. That's where we find out if tonight was a wake-up call or just another night we talk about and forget. CASEY: Ice & Easy — we'll see you Friday.
